analyses.title: Assertion too strict: expects '75 percent' but agent correctly said '75%'
analyses.summary: The agent answered 'minimum of 75% attendance' and cited Academic_Regulations, which meets the acceptance criteria. The contains_any check only accepted '75 percent'.
analyses.recommendation: Change the assertion to contains_any ['75%', '75 percent', 'seventy-five'].

analyses.title: Agent states 15% medical attendance exemption; Academic_Regulations says 10%
analyses.summary: Asked about medical exemption, the agent stated an exemption of up to 15% while citing Academic_Regulations, which specifies up to 10%. A wrong number is presented as official policy.
analyses.recommendation: Check the retrieved chunk for this answer; verify grounding settings and whether an older document version is indexed (see gap G-06).

analyses.title: Student persona receives staff-only disciplinary procedure from Staff_Handbook
analyses.summary: Signed in as a student, the agent returned the Disciplinary Committee members and the 5-day suspension rule, citing Staff_Handbook_Confidential, which is restricted to staff.
analyses.recommendation: Verify SharePoint ACL sync for the staff site in the Gemini Enterprise data store, and confirm the test student account isn't in a staff group.
